chunks: Muhammad ibn alhammad ibn al-Hasan (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee', from Muhammad ibn 'Adhafir, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

He said: While the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was on one of his journeys, a group of riders met him and said: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah. He said: Who are you? They said: We are believers. He said: What is the reality of your faith? They said: Satisfaction with the decree of Allah, submission to the command of Allah, and entrustment to Allah, Exalted is He. He said: Wise scholars, who are on the verge of being prophets due to wisdom. If you are truthful, then do not build wealth that you will not dwell in, and do not accumulate what you will not consume, and fear Allah to whom you will return.
ai.seo_question: What is the definition of true faith and the practical test of sincerity according to this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Mani al-Akhbar* highlights the Shia emphasis on the integration of spiritual contentment (*rida*) with practical asceticism (*zuhd*), where the Prophet validates the travelers' theological stance but grounds it in tangible detachment from worldly accumulation. The description of them as 'wise scholars on the verge of prophethood' underscores the high status of those who combine deep understanding with piety, a concept central to Shia epistemology. The exhortation against hoarding wealth for idle construction serves as a timeless critique of materialism, linking inner faith to outer economic behavior.

en.basel-kadem: 6.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammed ibn Hussain bin Abi’l-Khattab, from Muhammed bin Isma’eel bin Bazee’, from Muhammed bin ‘Adhafir, from his father, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him,

that he said: The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, was with us during some of his journeys, as a convoy met him and said: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah. So he said: What are you? They said: We are believers. He said: What is the reality of your faith? He said: Satisfaction with the decision of Allah, submission to the commandment of Allah and entrustment to Allah, Exalted is He. Then he said: Wise scholars, as if they are to be, due to wisdom, Prophets. Hence, if you are truthful, then do not built that which you will not dwell in, and do not gather that which you will not consume, and fear Allah to Whom you will return.
